summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature (module-level functions and Progress methods, private reader and context wrapper) across rich/progress.py, tests/test_progress.py, docs/source/progress.rst, and CHANGELOG.md. The diff is additive only and nothing is committed. Nothing was run: no tests, mypy, or black. Unverified: (1) mypy strict may need a return-value/type-var suppression on module-level open, which I did not add; (2) on Python 3.6, typing.BinaryIO's abstract mode/name may stop the reader from instantiating, so I did not add delegating properties; (3) the new tests have not been executed.
